title: Adult Human Lung Cell Dissociation Protocol
author: Andrew Potter

steps.title: Mince tissue with enzyme mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 13 mg lung tissue to a petri dish on ice containing 100 µL enzyme mix; mince with a razor blade for 2 min until the tissue is finely broken up.

steps.title: Combine minced tissue with enzyme
steps.instruction: Transfer the 13 mg minced tissue into a 1.5 mL tube that already contains 900 µL enzyme mix (total volume 1 mL) using a cut P200 pipette tip.

steps.title: Incubate and triturate first digest
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 30 min, performing ten triturations with a 1 mL pipette set to 700 µL every 3 min (tip cut) and shaking the tube 3–5 times every 2 min; after incubation let the suspension settle on ice for 1 min.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and filter
steps.instruction: Pipette off and retain 80 % of the supernatant (released cells), leaving undigested tissue chunks at the bottom; transfer the supernatant to a sterile 30 µM filter placed in a 15 mL conical tube, rinse the filter with 12 mL ice‑cold 10 % FBS/PBS, and tap to ensure cell passage.

steps.title: Centrifuge first filtrate
steps.instruction: Spin the 15 mL conical containing the filtered cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in buffer
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the cell pellet in 14 mL ice‑cold 10 % FBS/PBS, and keep on ice while proceeding.

steps.title: Add second enzyme aliquot
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL enzyme mix to the residual tissue chunks remaining from the first layer.

steps.title: Incubate and triturate second digest
steps.instruction: Continue incubation on ice for an additional 40 min (total 1 h 10 min), performing ten triturations with a 1 mL pipette set to 700 µL every 3 min (tip cut if needed) and shaking 3–5 times every 2 min.

steps.title: Filter second digest
steps.instruction: After the total 1 h 10 min incubation, triturate the digest mixture ten times and transfer the entire digest (including any remaining chunks) to a new sterile 30 µM filter in a 15 mL conical tube; rinse the filter with 12 mL ice‑cold 10 % FBS/PBS.

steps.title: RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Combine all supernatants, resuspend the combined volume in 5 mL RBC lysis buffer, pipette up and down 20 times to mix, and incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Dilute and filter post‑lysis
steps.instruction: Add 9 mL ice‑cold 10 % FBS/PBS to the lysate, triturate, and apply the suspension to a sterile 30 µM filter in a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Split flow‑through and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Divide the flow‑through into two 15 mL conical tubes and bring each to a final volume of 14 mL with ice‑cold 10 % FBS/PBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge final suspensions
steps.instruction: Spin each tube at 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend and assess viability
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellets in 100 µL ice‑cold 10 % FBS/PBS, then determine viability and cell count using a hemocytometer with trypan blue.

steps.title: Adjust concentration for 10x
steps.instruction: Dilute or concentrate the suspension to achieve 700–1200 cells µL⁻¹ for loading onto the 10× Chromium system.

steps.title: Final spin of layers
steps.instruction: Remove any remaining filters and spin the two 15 mL conical tubes (first and second layers) at 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
